1. Before: `tz = FixedTzOffset(offset, tz)` - used the raw timezone string as the name
2. After: `tzname = '%s%02d:%02d' % (sign, int(tzh), int(tzm))` followed by `tz = FixedTzOffset(offset, tzname)` - normalizes to HH:MM format
